decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet shelf display is a flexible core format close to the established offer, but its absence from the website since 2020 suggests weakening attention.
The pegboard-back variant is a more specialised format that is no longer shown online, and its capacity would serve the core display business and new development better.
The standard quarter-pallet shelf display is a staple retail format with steady brand demand and costs little to keep in the range, even though it is no longer featured online.
